name: mytodoease
description: TodoEase - a planner that keeps tasks and calendar on one screen: ASP.NET Core + embedded LiteDB backend, React front end, Electron desktop shell, Firebase web app.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,desktop -c blue,green,magenta "npm run api" "npm run web" "npm run desktop"
scripts.build:appbar: dotnet publish desktop/appbar/MyTodoEase.AppBar.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o desktop/build/appbar
scripts.build:api: dotnet publish backend/MyTodoEase.Api/MyTodoEase.Api.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o desktop/build/api
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build:site && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:appbar && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:web && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.release: npm run build:api && npm run build:appbar && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:web && npm run release -w desktop
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build -w mcp && npm run bundle -w mcp
